findings.title: Write endpoints lack idempotency
findings.description: Write endpoints (POST /api/orders, POST /api/returns, POST /api/admin/users) use uniqid() for ID generation with no idempotency key support. Repeated calls create duplicate records.
findings.gap: No idempotency key parameter accepted on any write endpoint. No unique business-key constraints prevent duplicate creation on retry.
findings.recommendation: Implement X-Idempotency-Key header support on all POST endpoints that stores and deduplicates requests within a 24-hour window.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no idempotency mechanism on write endpoints.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Agents retry on failure and LLM non-determinism causes duplicate tool calls. POST /api/orders creates a new order on every call with no deduplication.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add X-Idempotency-Key header check to POST /api/orders
blocker_remediation.target_state: All write endpoints accept and enforce idempotency keys

findings.title: No machine identity authentication
findings.description: Authentication is exclusively session-based using PHP sessions with username/password login via HTML form. No OAuth2 client credentials, no API key authentication, no mTLS support.
findings.gap: No machine identity mechanism exists. An agent cannot authenticate programmatically with principal attribution.
findings.recommendation: Implement API key authentication with principal attribution or OAuth2 client credentials flow for /api/* endpoints.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Implement API key authentication as parallel auth mechanism for /api/* endpoints
blocker_remediation.target_state: OAuth2 client credentials flow with per-agent identity and audit attribution

findings.title: No immutable audit logging
findings.description: Order status changes logged to mutable MySQL table (order_status_history). No immutable log storage, no CloudTrail, no tamper-evident logging.
findings.gap: No immutable, tamper-evident audit trail. Database records can be modified or deleted.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudTrail with log file validation enabled and route application audit events to CloudWatch Logs with KMS encryption.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND no immutable audit trail for write operations.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Write-enabled agents must have full audit attribution. The order_status_history table is mutable and provides no tamper evidence.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add CloudTrail logging with log file validation
blocker_remediation.target_state: Immutable audit trail with CloudTrail + S3 Object Lock recording authenticated principal for every write

findings.title: No compensation or rollback for multi-step workflows
findings.description: Individual operations use DB transactions but the multi-step fulfillment workflow (validate → assign → pick → pack → QC → ship → deliver) has no compensation logic. Each step commits independently.
findings.gap: No saga pattern. No compensating transactions. No undo endpoints for fulfillment steps.
findings.recommendation: Implement compensation endpoints for each fulfillment step and adopt saga pattern with rollback states.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND multi-step fulfillment workflow has no compensation logic.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: An agent executing the fulfillment workflow may succeed on steps 1-4 and fail on step 5. Without compensation, the system is left in a partial state with no recovery path.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Add compensation endpoints for each fulfillment step
blocker_remediation.target_state: Saga pattern with compensating actions for each step or Step Functions with error handling

findings.title: No data residency controls for stored PII
findings.description: Customer PII (names, emails, addresses, payment records) stored with no data residency controls or documentation. No mechanism prevents an agent from transmitting PII to an LLM in a different jurisdiction.
findings.gap: No data residency policy. No region restrictions. No data classification. No compliance controls.
findings.recommendation: Document applicable data residency requirements, classify stored data, and configure AWS region restrictions via SCPs.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: Resolved to BLOCKER: agent_scope=write-enabled AND PII stored without residency controls.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: The system stores customer PII subject to privacy regulations. Write-enabled agents could transmit this data to LLM providers in other jurisdictions without guardrails.

blocker_remediation.immediate: Document applicable data residency requirements and classify stored data
blocker_remediation.target_state: Data residency policy enforced at infrastructure level with guardrails preventing LLM-bound data from crossing jurisdictional boundaries

findings.title: No action-level authorization within admin role
findings.description: Admin role has unrestricted access to all admin endpoints with no action-level granularity. Cannot grant read orders without delete users.
findings.gap: No fine-grained RBAC or ABAC within admin scope. Binary admin/customer distinction only.
findings.recommendation: Implement action-level middleware mapping roles to permitted HTTP methods and URL patterns.

compensating_controls: Create dedicated fulfillment-agent role
Implement per-route action-level middleware

findings.title: No identity propagation or delegation
findings.description: No identity propagation mechanism exists. Session-based auth with no JWT/OAuth token exchange or on-behalf-of flows.
findings.gap: Cannot distinguish agent-as-self vs agent-on-behalf-of-user. No token-based delegation.
findings.recommendation: Implement OAuth2 with on-behalf-of token exchange allowing agents to carry delegated user identity.

compensating_controls: Require X-On-Behalf-Of headers logged and validated
Implement service account with explicit user context parameter

findings.title: Hardcoded credential fallbacks in source code
findings.description: Database credentials have hardcoded fallback values in code (getenv('DB_PASS') ?: 'ecommerce_pass'). No secrets manager integration. No rotation.
findings.gap: Hardcoded fallback credentials. No AWS Secrets Manager or Vault. No rotation mechanism.
findings.recommendation: Remove hardcoded fallbacks, integrate AWS Secrets Manager with automatic rotation for RDS credentials.

compensating_controls: Remove hardcoded fallback values immediately
Use Secrets Manager with automatic rotation

findings.title: No agent identity suspension mechanism
findings.description: User accounts can only be deleted entirely. No mechanism to suspend or disable without destroying the identity record.
findings.gap: No active/inactive/suspended status field. Cannot revoke access without destroying audit attribution.
findings.recommendation: Add status field (active/suspended/disabled) to users table and check during authentication.

compensating_controls: Add active boolean column to users table
Implement API key revocation per AUTH-Q1 remediation

findings.title: No concurrency controls for write operations
findings.description: No optimistic or pessimistic locking. Concurrent agent instances could create race conditions on status transitions and inventory operations.
findings.gap: No version fields, ETags, If-Match headers, or conditional writes.
findings.recommendation: Implement optimistic locking with version fields on the orders table and conditional UPDATE statements.

compensating_controls: Add version columns for optimistic locking
Use SELECT FOR UPDATE on critical paths

findings.title: No rate limiting or throttling
findings.description: WAF has IP whitelisting but no rate-based rules. No application-level rate limiting. Runaway agent loops would not be throttled.
findings.gap: No per-IP or per-user rate limiting at WAF or application level.
findings.recommendation: Add WAF rate-based rules and implement application-level per-user request throttling.

compensating_controls: Add WAF rate-based rules (100 req/5min/IP)
Implement PHP middleware for per-session throttling

findings.title: No blast radius or transaction limits
findings.description: No configurable transaction limits. An agent with admin access could approve unlimited returns, delete unlimited users, or create unlimited orders without caps.
findings.gap: No per-caller business transaction limits. No batch caps. No spend thresholds.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable per-identity business transaction limits enforced at the application layer.

compensating_controls: Implement per-session operation counters
Add rate-based business rules (max 10 returns/hour)

findings.title: No configurable approval gates
findings.description: Return approval is hardcoded. Cannot configure other operations to require approval without code changes.
findings.gap: No configurable operation-level approval flags. No approval workflow engine.
findings.recommendation: Implement configurable approval framework that allows operations to be flagged for human approval by type or value threshold.

compensating_controls: Implement generic approval middleware per endpoint
Use Step Functions with human approval tasks

findings.title: No access control differentiation for sensitive data
findings.description: Stage A=YES (PII stored). B1=CLEAR (passwords excluded from responses). B2=FIRES (admin role grants undifferentiated access to all sensitive data). B3=absent.
findings.gap: Single admin role grants undifferentiated access to all data including customer PII and payment records. No OAuth scopes or granular permissions.
findings.recommendation: Implement role-based data access scoping with separate authorization for PII-containing endpoints.

ara_metadata.conditional_resolution: B2 sub-check fires as RISK-SAFETY: no access control differentiation for sensitive data domains.
ara_metadata.resolution_reasoning: Admin role grants access to all sensitive data without scope differentiation. An agent granted admin access inherits full PII access.

b1.reasoning: Passwords properly excluded from GET /api/admin/users response via explicit column selection.

b2.reasoning: Single admin role grants undifferentiated access to all data. No OAuth scopes or data-domain granularity.

b3.reasoning: No formal classification metadata (no tags, no annotations, no Macie).

compensating_controls: Create separate endpoints with different auth for sensitive vs non-sensitive data
Implement OAuth scopes per data domain

findings.title: No PII redaction in logs or error responses
findings.description: PHP error logging enabled with no PII redaction. Exception messages exposed in API responses via json_encode(['error' => $e->getMessage()]).
findings.gap: No PII masking. No log scrubbing. Raw exception messages returned to clients and potentially logged.
findings.recommendation: Replace raw exception messages with generic errors in API responses. Implement logging wrapper with PII redaction.

compensating_controls: Sanitize exception messages before returning in API responses
Implement structured logging with field allowlist

findings.title: No machine-readable API specification
findings.description: No OpenAPI, Swagger, AsyncAPI, GraphQL schema, or Smithy specification. All 25+ API routes defined inline in index.php.
findings.gap: No machine-readable API specification file. Agent tool generation requires manual source code inspection.
findings.recommendation: Create an OpenAPI 3.0 specification documenting all /api/* endpoints with request/response schemas.

findings.title: Unstructured error responses
findings.description: Error responses use simple {"error": "message"} format. No error codes, no retryable classification, no field-level detail.
findings.gap: No structured error taxonomy. Agents cannot distinguish retriable from terminal errors.
findings.recommendation: Implement structured error envelope: {"error": {"code": "...", "message": "...", "retryable": bool, "details": [...]}}.

findings.title: No pagination on list endpoints
findings.description: List endpoints return all records without pagination: GET /api/products, GET /api/orders/me, GET /api/admin/orders/pending-fulfillment. No limit, offset, or cursor parameters.
findings.gap: No pagination. No result size limits. Unbounded result sets.
findings.recommendation: Add limit and offset query parameters to all list endpoints with default limit of 50.

findings.title: Insufficient input validation with unstructured errors
findings.description: Partial validation exists (required field checks, prepared statements) but error responses lack field-level detail. No JSON schema validation middleware.
findings.gap: No schema validation. Unstructured validation errors. Agents cannot identify which field failed.
findings.recommendation: Implement field-level validation with structured error responses identifying field, constraint, and accepted format.

findings.title: No freshness signaling despite timestamps existing
findings.description: Timestamps exist (created_at, updated_at) but no timezone normalization, no Cache-Control headers, no freshness signaling.
findings.gap: No explicit UTC storage. No freshness headers. Agents cannot determine data currency.
findings.recommendation: Standardize timestamps to UTC with ISO 8601 format and add Last-Modified/Cache-Control headers.

findings.title: No schema versioning or API contracts
findings.description: No API versioning, no database migrations, no breaking change detection, no contract testing.
findings.gap: No versioning at any layer. Agent tool bindings break silently on any code change.
findings.recommendation: Implement /v1/ API versioning and adopt database migration framework.

findings.title: No distributed tracing or structured logging
findings.description: No X-Ray, no OpenTelemetry, no structured JSON logging, no correlation IDs. Agent-initiated requests are not traceable.
findings.gap: No trace propagation. No structured logs. Cannot debug agent-initiated failures.
findings.recommendation: Implement JSON structured logging with correlation IDs and integrate AWS X-Ray.

findings.title: No alerting on error rates or latency
findings.description: No CloudWatch alarms configured. RDS monitoring without alerting. No anomaly detection.
findings.gap: No alerting for API degradation. Degradation undetected until agents fail.
findings.recommendation: Add CloudWatch alarms for App Runner 5xx rate, P99 latency, and RDS CPU.

findings.title: Partial infrastructure governance (IaC exists, no review or drift detection)
findings.description: CloudFormation template exists but no CI/CD enforces peer review. No drift detection. 1/3 governance sub-checks pass.
findings.gap: No review enforcement for IaC changes. No drift detection.
findings.recommendation: Implement CI pipeline with cfn-lint, peer review requirement, and AWS Config drift detection.

findings.title: No CI/CD pipeline
findings.description: No CI/CD pipeline exists. Manual deployment via deploy.sh (docker-compose). No automated testing.
findings.gap: No CI/CD. No automated tests. No contract testing. No breaking change detection.
findings.recommendation: Create CI/CD pipeline with automated API tests and contract validation.

findings.title: No explicit rollback capability
findings.description: No blue/green deployment, no canary, no automated rollback. Deploy.sh uses docker-compose with no versioning.
findings.gap: No automated rollback triggers. Manual intervention required.
findings.recommendation: Configure App Runner auto-rollback on health check failures with tagged immutable container images.

findings.title: Zero automated test coverage
findings.description: No test files, no test framework, no test dependencies. Zero coverage of 25+ API endpoints.
findings.gap: No tests at all. No PHPUnit, no Postman collections, no integration tests.
findings.recommendation: Add PHPUnit with API integration tests covering order creation, fulfillment, returns, and user management.

findings.title: No event emission for state changes
findings.description: No event emission. Order status changes written to database only. No webhooks, SNS, EventBridge, or Kafka.
findings.gap: No mechanism for agents to subscribe to state change events.
findings.recommendation: Consider adding SNS notifications for order status transitions.

findings.title: No rate limit documentation or headers
findings.description: WAF configured but no rate limit headers returned. No rate limit documentation for agent consumption.
findings.gap: No X-RateLimit-Remaining or Retry-After headers.
findings.recommendation: Document rate limits and return rate limit headers from the application.

findings.title: No data quality metrics or monitoring
findings.description: No data quality dashboards, profiling, or freshness SLAs. No null rate or duplicate monitoring.
findings.gap: No data quality awareness for agent reliability estimation.
findings.recommendation: Implement basic data quality monitoring on critical fields.

findings.title: No data catalog or metadata layer
findings.description: No data catalog, metadata files, or data dictionary. Schema only discoverable in PHP source code.
findings.gap: No structured metadata beyond inline SQL DDL.
findings.recommendation: Create data dictionary documenting table schemas and relationships.

findings.title: No business outcome metrics
findings.description: No custom business metrics. Only infrastructure-level monitoring (VPC Flow Logs, RDS Enhanced Monitoring).
findings.gap: Cannot measure whether agent operations produce good business outcomes.
findings.recommendation: Publish CloudWatch custom metrics for fulfillment time and order error rates.

evaluations.title: Documented API Interface
evaluations.reason: Application exposes 25+ REST API endpoints under /api/* with JSON responses. Integration is via HTTP REST, not direct database or UI.

evaluations.title: Structured Response Format
evaluations.reason: All API responses are JSON with Content-Type: application/json header.

evaluations.title: Asynchronous Operation Support
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — no individual operations exceed 30 seconds.

evaluations.title: Scoped Permissions (Least Privilege)
evaluations.reason: Two roles (admin/customer) with differentiated access levels. IAM roles in CloudFormation use least-privilege policies.

evaluations.title: Queryable Current State
evaluations.reason: GET endpoints expose current state: products, orders, order history, pending fulfillment.

evaluations.title: Circuit Breakers and Resilience
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — monolith only communicates with its own MySQL database, no external service calls.

evaluations.title: Graceful Degradation Signaling
evaluations.reason: Extended question not triggered — priority not specified and service not identified as critical path.

evaluations.title: Draft/Pending State
evaluations.reason: Returns use pending_review status requiring approval. Orders proceed through multi-step status machine with reviewable intermediate states.

evaluations.title: Sandbox/Staging Environment
evaluations.reason: Docker Compose provides local testing environment with MySQL and automatic seed data generation.

evaluations.title: Semantically Meaningful Field Names
evaluations.reason: Field names are human-readable and semantically meaningful (customer_id, total_amount, stock_quantity). No legacy abbreviations.

evaluations.title: Encryption at Rest
evaluations.reason: RDS StorageEncrypted: true, ECR KMS encryption with customer-managed key, VPC Flow Logs KMS-encrypted.

items.summary: Resolve all 5 BLOCKERs and highest-priority RISK-SAFETY findings to unblock agent pilot consideration.
Address remaining RISK-SAFETY and core RISK-QUALITY findings to enable supervised pilot deployment.
Implement quality improvements and observability enhancements for production-grade agent operation.

recommended_actions.action: Deploy centralized identity provider with machine identity support
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine identity is the foundational blocker — without it, no agent can authenticate, audit trails have no attribution, and identity cannot be suspended.
Write safety requires both idempotent endpoints (prevents duplicates on retry) and compensation logic (enables rollback on partial failure).

recommended_actions.action: Establish data governance and residency controls
recommended_actions.rationale: PII is stored without classification, residency controls, or log redaction — regulatory and reputational risk at agent speed.

recommended_actions.action: Add rate limiting and transaction guardrails
recommended_actions.rationale: Prevent runaway agent loops and unbounded blast radius from overwhelming or corrupting the system.

recommended_actions.action: Create OpenAPI specification and CI/CD pipeline
recommended_actions.rationale: Machine-readable API spec enables automated tool generation; CI/CD with contract testing prevents silent breakage.
